body:
## Scope · Confidential legal intake (public coordination metadata only)

Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_SOURCE_MATERIAL_OFF_REPOSITORY.
An administrative project/work-unit index, not a source-code candidate, runtime effect or EAP/EMP acknowledgment.

### Purpose
Track an owner-directed legal-document intake, prior-source correlation, preservation and counsel handoff as a separate workstream of the authority repository.
**Security boundary:** The public repository must not contain original scans, personally identifying case files, attorney-client communications or new unsubstantiated allegations against identifiable people. Those remain in a separate confidential dossier for the owner.

### Previously published source
- Existing first-person narrative: https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/blob/main/docs/Die_Spirale_des_entscheidenden_Unterschieds.md . Treat this as a SELF_REPORT, not independently verified proof.
- Current repository work-intake/governance: https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/issues/758 . Dynamically discover subsequent related work; do not hardcode an execution candidate.

### Verified private intake metadata (no case identifiers)
- Two JPEG images of a two-page document, provided by the owner in this conversation on 2026-11-19, preserved bit-for-bit unchanged.
- Page 1 SHA-256: bdf95e93d921e6f4fa94d90be31441e6c5151646ebd04325730a821c0029b87a.
- Page 2 SHA-256: 3e7d18652b64d8689c91a59cffc65ea3a480d6e83bd0c4b93bf748ae006f0840.
- Private local dossier assembled: provenance metadata, legal-source reading, evidence matrix, timeline reconciliation questions, attorney email draft, original photo copies and checksum manifest. **These files are not stored in the public repository or mirrored.**

### Workstream and acceptance
- [x] Preserve source bytes, compute digest, record a source inventory.
- [x] Find and compare the earlier published account, preserving epistemic distinctions.
- [x] Verify counsel address, prepare an unsent email draft with the two source photographs.
- [ ] Confirm actual counsel handoff, attachment acceptance and mandate.
- [ ] Verify actual receipt date, procedural deadlines and authorized representation.
- [ ] Obtain competent case-file access and assess originating complaint, witness accounts, documentary evidence.
- [ ] Build a source-timestamped chronology, check whether locations and persons coincide, investigate independent corroboration and alternative explanations.
- [ ] Separately assess relevance of earlier administrative events; avoid assuming coordination or causality.
- [ ] Close only upon counsel-reviewed conclusion and readback; no unsupported effect acknowledgment.

State: COUNSEL_DRAFT_PREPARED / UNSENT / CASE_FILE_NOT_OBTAINED / VERIFICATION_CONTINUES.
No repository source mutation, no CI re-trigger, no new execution controller.

<!-- confidential-legal-supplement-20261119-v2 -->
### Counsel-preparation update · 2026-11-19

The owner has provided further case-context which has been added **only to the confidential off-repository dossier**, not published here. This public work-unit records the updated execution and evidence gates:

- [x] Prepare a revised attorney draft; confirm the two original document photographs are attached to the saved draft (provider-side attachment-name readback, not a delivery receipt).
- [x] Preserve original source bytes and current SHA-256 ledger in the confidential package; previous versions remain distinguishable.
- [ ] **Urgently request preservation** of any claimed audiovisual recordings, with written confirmation of whether such recordings exist, their retention policy, and whether they were actually secured. A reported recording is **not** verified video evidence.
- [ ] Obtain counsel-led review of the factual chronology, eyewitness accounts, official records and legal basis for any state interventions, including potential constitutional-rights issues.
- [ ] Determine objectively whether any accusation was knowingly false or any coercive measure unlawful; do not equate a self-report or a suspicion with a proven offence.
- [ ] Verify any procedural deadlines, counsel mandate, actual receipt, and evidence disclosures independently.

**Current fixpoint:** `DRAFT_SAVED_WITH_TWO_ATTACHMENTS`; `UNSENT`; `VIDEO_EXISTENCE_UNKNOWN`; `LEGAL_MERITS_UNADJUDICATED`; `COUNSEL_INTAKE_PENDING`. No EAP/EMP production acknowledgment or private evidence publication is implied.


<!-- confidential-legal-chronology-international-gate-20261119-v3 -->
### Chronology correction and international/privacy workstreams · 2026-11-19

**CONFIRMED intake correction:** The dated allegation in the received official document and a separately reported incident involving other authorities must not be silently merged into one calendar day or one event. Any dates and causal links not established from source records remain `UNKNOWN`. A verified external source is required before adding a cross-event timeline edge.

**Restricted off-repository case-dossier revision 4:** a corrected event matrix and counsel draft exist locally; the original uploaded evidence photographs were kept byte-identical with existing digests. The case dossier contains confidential particulars **not reproduced in this public issue**. The earlier source remains a first-person report, not independent proof.

**Governed follow-ups (not evidence of wrongdoing):**
- [x] Correct the temporal separation in the private dossier and new counsel draft.
- [x] Save a clearly superseding counsel email draft with both original-source photos (attachment names confirmed by Outlook readback); the draft is **not sent**.
- [x] Save a separate, neutral data-subject-access request as **draft only**; this does not show the queried data exist.
- [ ] Obtain independent official dates, primary files, witness accounts and any recordings for each distinct incident; establish land/venue boundaries from original sources.
- [ ] Seek urgent preservation of recordings **if extant**, with provider acknowledgment; do not infer existence or preservation from an owner's description.
- [ ] Evaluate any cross-jurisdictional issue first with counsel and competent national authorities; Europol referral only if supported and routed through proper authorities.
- [ ] Confirm whether any third-party controller actually processes relevant personal data; rely on lawful data subject rights and independent source readback rather than speculation.
- [ ] Keep earlier unrelated national-authority matters as separate evidence streams until specific proof justifies linking them.

**Current status:** `PRIVATE_REV4_PREPARED`; `COUNSEL_DRAFT_UNSENT`; `PRIVACY_DRAFT_UNSENT`; `EXTERNAL_RESPONSES_NONE`; `MULTI_EVENT_CAUSALITY_UNVERIFIED`. No Main code change, no new writer, no EAP/EMP effect acknowledgment.


<!-- confidential-legal-priority-revision-20261119-v5 -->
### Priority correction / confidential counsel dossier REV5 · 2026-11-19

A revised, confidential attorney preparation package has been created locally; it **does not** publish confidential allegations or attachments. The owner expressly changed the **order of operations**:

1. **P0 – Documentary legal defense:** The sole official notice at hand is a dated allegation of trespass. Secure receipt/deadline, counsel mandate, exact alleged location/actions, prior exclusion notice, underlying application/complaint, evidentiary statements, and defense file access. Do not treat an allegation as proven.
2. **P1 – Separate and later self-reported complex:** Another alleged property offense, police contact and possible evidentiary records are said to have occurred at a later unknown date. **Do not merge with P0's event date**. Verify chronology and any causal relationship only from independent records. Preserve possible recordings promptly.
3. **P2 – Third-party personal-data inquiry:** A draft Article 15 GDPR access request is a method to determine whether a third-party entity actually processes any relevant data. There is currently **no independent evidence** that such a third-party data record exists.
4. **Deferred:** Older cross-border authority-related experiences are **self-reports**, not established a common mechanism. Do not mix spiritual/philosophical narratives or unrelated country events into the immediate defense.

**Readback requirements:** Counsel draft content and two JPEG filenames independently verified in the mail provider; both source files remain byte-identical. Local dossier revised to REV5; not mirrored, not sent or publicly committed. Sending, external counsel receipt, actual video preservation, file inspection, and forensic attribution remain NOT_DONE/UNKNOWN.

**State:** `P0_ATTORNEY_DRAFT_REV5_SAVED` | `P0_OFFICIAL_CASE_FILE_NOT_OBTAINED` | `P1_CHRONOLOGY_OPEN` | `P2_DATA_REQUEST_UNSENT` | `LEGAL_FACTUAL_DETERMINATIONS_OPEN`. No code or existing CI candidate mutation; no EAP/EMP effect claim.
